reference.code: export function orderChanges(v:Array<[number,number,number,number,number]>):number[]|null{const a=v.map(x=>[...x]as[number,number,number,number,number]),seen=new Set<number>();for(const x of a){if(seen.has(x[0])||x.some(y=>!Number.isSafeInteger(y))||x.slice(1).some(y=>y<0))return null;seen.add(x[0])}a.sort((x,y)=>x[1]-y[1]||x[2]-y[2]||x[3]-y[3]||x[4]-y[4]||x[0]-y[0]);return a.map(x=>x[0])}
